_about: Labels of the public tracker (docs/s4/Issue_and_Release_Process.md §3). Applied with tools/s4/sync_labels.py --apply; nothing is deleted.

labels.name: type:problem
labels.description: Something does not work as described

labels.name: type:false-refusal
labels.description: A SIN or card-number guard refused ordinary data

labels.name: type:idea
labels.description: An improvement or a new capability

labels.name: type:question
labels.description: How to install, use or upgrade

labels.name: status:triage
labels.description: New; the Owner has not looked at it yet

labels.name: status:accepted
labels.description: Will be fixed or built; not yet assigned to a release

labels.name: status:released
labels.description: Fixed in a published release (see the milestone)

labels.name: status:wontfix
labels.description: Not changed; the reason is in the last comment

labels.name: impact:blocker
labels.description: An essential task cannot be done

labels.name: impact:wrong-result
labels.description: A figure, balance or report is wrong

labels.name: privacy:redacted
labels.description: The privacy guard or the Owner removed a sensitive value
